note: The OLG adequately covers the policy content of FNS 1064. FNS requires that status reporting households only report earned income changes in source, hourly rate/salary, or employment status (part-time to full-time or vice versa). The OLG covers these same triggers in multiple places: (1) 'Verifying Earned Income at Interim Report' states clients must verify earned income changes 'due to pay per hour, salary amount, source of income, starting, stopping or changing full-time or part-time status'; (2) 'Simplified Reporting Examples' Q1/A1 lists the same triggers for when income changes must be reported; (3) 'Reporting Requirements During Case Maintenance' explains that Simplified Reporting households have minimal reporting outside of application, IR, and recertification — only gross income exceeding the limit or ABAWD work hours. The bulk of FNS 1064 (Steps 1-5) describes QC review procedures for comparing verified income to EW amounts, which is audit methodology with no caseworker equivalent and does not need OLG coverage.
